description: This file defines types, utility functions, and API calls for browser management, profiling, tab control, and snapshotting in a browser automation context.

methods.name: buildProfileQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query string for profile parameter.

methods.name: withBaseUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, trimming slashes.

methods.name: browserProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of available browser profiles.

methods.name: browserTabs
methods.description: Retrieves open tabs in the browser.

methods.name: browserOpenTab
methods.description: Opens a new tab with specified URL.

methods.name: browserFocusTab
methods.description: Focuses a tab by target ID.

methods.name: browserCloseTab
methods.description: Closes a tab by target ID.

methods.name: browserTabAction
methods.description: Performs actions on tabs such as list, new, close, or select.

methods.name: browserSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current browser state.
